Bradenton non-profits ranked by government grant revenue in 2024
N. L. Sawyer
Mcr Health Inc led non-profits in Bradenton, Florida in reported government grant revenue in 2024, with $12,038,689 in government grants reported in its IRS Form 990 filing and $162,596,250 in total revenue. Government grants made up 7.4% of its reported total revenue.
The ranking reflects non-profits with available Form 990-series government grant revenue data that met the ranking's data criteria and may not include every non-profit in the city.
The ranking is based on IRS Form 990 filings, the annual information returns most tax-exempt organizations file with the IRS. The form includes reported revenue, expenses, assets, governance information and compensation paid to certain people, making it a public source for comparing large tax-exempt organizations' finances.
The figures reflect what each organization reported for its filing year, including total revenue, contributions, government grants, compensation, the number of employees and assets at the start and end of the year. Because nonprofits can differ by mission, structure and accounting period, the totals are best read as reported financial measures, not as a direct measure of local charitable activity.
Among the 10 ranked organizations with calculable government-grant shares, the median share was 15.7% of reported total revenue. Replay Outreach Inc reported the highest share of revenue from government grants at 87.4%.
In 2024, Mcr Health Inc reported $12,038,689 in government grant revenue, up from $11,710,475 in the prior year, an increase of $328,214 or 2.8%. Manatee County Girls Club Inc reported $2,165,962 in government grants, up from $2,095,088, a $70,874 or 3.4% increase. Meals on Wheels Plus of Manatee Inc. reported $2,023,671 in government grants, down from $2,663,520, a decrease of $639,849 or 24.0%.
Mcr Health Inc reported $15,279,050 in total contributions in 2024. Of that total, $3,240,361 was categorized as all other contributions. Meals on Wheels Plus of Manatee Inc. reported $11,447,642 in total contributions, with $9,156,480 categorized as all other contributions and $6,812,621 reported as non-cash. Bishop Museum Of Science And Nature Inc reported $5,747,325 in total contributions, with $4,576,721 as all other contributions. Mcr Health Inc reported $100,800,822 in total assets at the beginning of the year and $93,884,291 at year end, a decrease of 6.9%. Bishop Museum Of Science And Nature Inc reported an asset balance decrease of 18.3%, from $42,391,492 to $34,620,833.
Tax-exempt organizations include a wide range of groups, such as charities, foundations, educational institutions and other mission-driven organizations. Under IRS rules, 501(c)(3) organizations must be organized and operated for exempt purposes, and their earnings cannot benefit private shareholders or individuals.
